text_block_list.text:
I came to a shrine with El Condor Pasa to 
take a break and refresh our minds.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-hehh~♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, desu! Today I came to accept a 
challenge from God Himself, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
According to Fukukitaru-senpai, if you can 
walk from the torii gate to that tree with 
your eyes closed, your wish will come 
true, DESU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: In other words, this is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Reach this place and your wish shall be 
granted’—so it is a challenge from God!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am certain that must be it, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the dream of becoming the 
world's strongest is for El to fulfill 
herself! I have no intention of begging 
God for it, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I must accept the challenge! Otherwise, 
the name of El will be disgraced!

Saying that, El Condor Pasa put a 
blindfold over her mask and slowly started 
walking, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I touched it... This sensation is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! We made it to the tree!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ever-victorious, unstoppable, absolute win 
for El! This match goes to meee!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, it's really not that big a deal~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this means El's dream is even 
closer to becoming a reality, DESU!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
After all, I have God's blessing! No one 
can stop El noooow!

It looks like El Condor Pasa's condition 
has improved.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is it about time, I wonder...?
(Thump)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Owch!? Ow-ow-ow-ow!?

After running into a tree, El Condor Pasa 
vigorously ripped off her blindfold... 
Only to pull her mask off right along with 
it.
(VRROOO!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Keke!? My maaaask is...!

An ill-timed gust of wind blew El Condor 
Pasa's mask away.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wait up~~! El's mask~~!

Maybe I'm being punished for challenging 
the gods half-heartedly...
